title: The self intersection of the diagonal, the Euler characteristic and the top Chern class

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a nonempty equidimensional smooth projective scheme the alternating sum of the Betti numbers equals the degree of the self intersection of the diagonal and equals the degree of the top Chern class of the tangent sheaf (statement lines 3537-3544). The proof (proof lines 3545-3588) computes the self intersection through the Gysin map and the conormal sheaf of the diagonal, and through the degree map and the Kunneth decomposition of the diagonal class. H3: two independent computations of the same invariant, written out in full.
